dedupe_keys.name: meteor tanzania flood hazard map fluvial undefended for return periods of 1 in 5 10 20 50 75 100 200 250 500 and 1000 years

description: This METEOR deposit contains Tanzania river-flood depth maps under an undefended assumption. SSBN Ltd (Fathom) identifies ten public ODbL 1.0 GeoTIFFs, covering 5 to 1000-year return periods at roughly 90 m, 3-arcsecond WGS84 resolution. Depths in metres come from a two-dimensional shallow-water model informed by MERIT elevation and river-network data. The files can help compare a baseline without defences against the separate defended Tanzania release in infrastructure flood-exposure simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this undefended set. A limitation is that the two releases were not raster-compared, so their cell-by-cell difference is unknown. The map does not describe actual levees or site-level protection, and the provider says global-scale inputs make it unsuitable for detailed engineering assessments. The national layers represent local return-period maxima, not a flood that occurs everywhere simultaneously. No GeoTIFF was downloaded or validated against observed Tanzania inundation.
